name: exists_eq_polynomial
statement: ℕ} {m : ℕ} (hm : Fintype.card Fq ^ d ≤ m) (b : Fq[X]) (hb : natDegree b ≤ d) (A : Fin m.succ → Fq[X]) (hA : ∀ i, degree (A i) < degree b) : ∃ i₀ i₁, i₀ ≠ i₁ ∧ A i₁ = A i₀

name: exists_approx_polynomial_aux
statement: ℕ} {m : ℕ} (hm : Fintype.card Fq ^ d ≤ m) (b : Fq[X]) (A : Fin m.succ → Fq[X]) (hA : ∀ i, degree (A i) < degree b) : ∃ i₀ i₁, i₀ ≠ i₁ ∧ degree (A i₁ - A i₀) < ↑(natDegree b - d)

name: exists_approx_polynomial
statement: Fq[X]} (hb : b ≠ 0) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (A : Fin (Fintype.card Fq ^ ⌈-log ε / log (Fintype.card Fq)⌉₊).succ → Fq[X]) : ∃ i₀ i₁, i₀ ≠ i₁ ∧ (cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b) : ℝ) < cardPowDegree b • ε

have_tree.name: h'
have_tree.type: A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b ≠ 0

name: cardPowDegree_anti_archimedean
statement: Fq[X]} {a : ℤ} (hxy : cardPowDegree (x - y) < a) (hyz : cardPowDegree (y - z) < a) : cardPowDegree (x - z) < a

name: exists_partition_polynomial_aux
statement: ℕ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {b : Fq[X]} (hb : b ≠ 0) (A : Fin n → Fq[X]) : ∃ t : Fin n → Fin (Fintype.card Fq ^ ⌈-log ε / log (Fintype.card Fq)⌉₊), ∀ i₀ i₁ : Fin n, t i₀ = t i₁ ↔ (cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b) : ℝ) < cardPowDegree b • ε

have_tree.body: exists_nonempty_j ⟨t' i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, fun i' hi' => anti_archim' hi ((ht' _ _).mp hi')⟩
